newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's M-Net may face licence change.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's M-Net may face licence change.

text.p: South African satellite broadcaster M-Net Ltd may face changes to its licence conditions under the terms of discussions with the government which end this week, the firm said on Tuesday.

The talks are being held to review the conditions in M-Net's licence and review any possible changes that needed making. The conditions cover things such as advertising and the period of free "open time" M-Net uses to advertise its channel to non-fee paying viewers.
M-Net chief executive Gerrie de Villiers told an analysts briefing that the exact nature of any changes was not yet decided.
"Our regulatory position is at risk, but we will see what the end of the week brings," he said.
But he added the discussions had taken place on a "positive basis".
